title: ICSE CLASS 8 — English | Reported Speech Direct Indirect

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect speech transformation of the sentence: 'He said, ‘I am reading a novel.’'

options.text: He said that he was reading a novel.
options.explanation: Correct transformation of present continuous to past continuous with pronoun change.

options.text: He said that he is reading a novel.
options.explanation: Incorrect because the tense remains present continuous instead of shifting to past.

options.text: He said that he had been reading a novel.
options.explanation: Incorrect because the tense shifts to past perfect continuous instead of past continuous.

options.text: He said that he has read a novel.
options.explanation: Incorrect because the tense changes to present perfect instead of past continuous.

questions.explanation: The present continuous tense ('am reading') in direct speech changes to past continuous ('was reading') in indirect speech. The pronoun 'I' changes to 'he', and 'that' is used as a conjunction.
questions.hint: Remember to change the tense and adjust pronouns when converting direct to indirect speech.
questions.subject: icse8-english

questions.explanation: The present perfect tense ('have finished') in direct speech changes to past perfect ('had finished') in indirect speech. The pronoun 'I' changes to 'she'.
